findings.standard: An Instar Agent Is Always a Multi-Machine Entity
findings.reason: A supported older relay can strip creation context before forwarding a created event, leaving an upgraded machine unable to recover a parent the agent already knows, with no pending-item receipt or repair obligation.

findings.standard: Verify the State, Not Its Symbol
findings.reason: Chief being disabled on the answering machine permits a creation-time parent to be displayed as current even though that configuration does not establish that no later explicit placement exists.

After a transient placement-snapshot read failure, an unchanged source version can leave placement unknown indefinitely because the design specifies no recurring retry or tracked recovery obligation for that state.

findings.standard: A Dispatch Supplies the Question and Withholds the Answer
findings.reason: The rollout directs the compatibility probe to record a predetermined result that the previous codec accepts the event and strips its context, compromising the independent check that determines whether writers can be enabled safely.

findings.standard: Attributed Statements Trace to Their Source
findings.reason: The testing gate attributes the full-suite routing restriction to an explicit operator instruction without quoting the operator or pointing to the logged message authorizing that restriction.
